module: Cruise control: a PID drives electrics.values.throttleOverride to keep the wheel speed (electrics.values.wheelspeed, m/s) at a setpoint. It stops on braking, after post-crash braking and does not drive the pedal if the driver presses the clutch or the throttle. A modder can drive it via setSpeed, changeSpeed, holdCurrentSpeed and setEnabled.
usage:
extensions.cruiseControl.setSpeed(100 / 3.6)  -- 100 km/h in m/s, enables the cruise control
extensions.cruiseControl.setEnabled(false)
notes: Units: speeds in m/s. M.minimumSpeed = 30 / 3.6 (30 km/h): the setpoint is always clamped to this minimum; holdCurrentSpeed does nothing if the current speed is lower.

Writes electrics.values.throttleOverride (nil when disabled), cruiseControlTarget (setpoint) and cruiseControlActive (boolean). Reads electrics.values.wheelspeed and postCrashBrakeTriggered. Sends the state to the UI with the 'CruiseControlState' hook ({targetSpeed, isEnabled}) if the first player is seated.

The setpoint is ramped (target acceleration 3 m/s², changeable by setTargetAcceleration) to avoid integrator windup; the PID is newPIDStandard(0.3, 2, 0, ...) and the output is smoothed by a temporal smoother.
If input.throttle > 0 or input.clutch > 0, the cruise control stays active but does not override the pedal: throttleOverride takes the value of input.throttle.
hasReachedTargetSpeed becomes true when the relative error to the setpoint is <= 3%.
disableOnReset (local, always false): the cruise control therefore stays armed on vehicle reset; only hasReachedTargetSpeed and the internal state are reset.
Anomaly: the onReset log says 'Cruise Control online' at each reset.

hasReachedTargetSpeed.desc: true when the speed is within 3% of the setpoint.

onReset.desc: Vehicle reset hook: resets hasReachedTargetSpeed, the state and the smoother to zero.

updateGFX.desc: Called every frame: if active, applies the PID regulation and handles the stop conditions.

setSpeed.desc: Enables the cruise control with the given setpoint (clamped to the minimum).

changeSpeed.desc: Enables the cruise control and adds an offset to the current setpoint.

holdCurrentSpeed.desc: Sets the setpoint to the current speed if it exceeds the minimum speed.

setEnabled.desc: Enables or disables the cruise control; resets throttleOverride to nil and the smoother to zero.

requestState.desc: Publishes the state (electrics.cruiseControlTarget/Active) and sends 'CruiseControlState' to the UI.

setTargetAcceleration.desc: Sets the acceleration (in m/s²) of the setpoint ramp.
